interpretations: Filter films to `replacement_cost > 20.99`. For each `rating`, calculate the average non-null `length` and the average of each film’s `rental_rate / replacement_cost`, ignoring null ratios. Return one unrounded row containing the unweighted average of the per-rating length averages, followed by the unweighted average of the per-rating ratio averages.
queries:
SELECT
  AVG(avg_length),
  AVG(avg_ratio)
FROM (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
);
